title: Options Earnings Implied Move Pro
description: Pre-earnings implied-move scanner for the 40-ticker Options Edge Brief watchlist. For each ticker with earnings within the next 7 days, joins to the existing earnings_calendar Parquet feed to identify the report date, then fetches the Massive options snapshot for the FIRST expiration after the earnings date. Locates the ATM call + ATM put nearest the underlying spot, computes the straddle premium (call_mid + put_mid), and derives the implied move percentage (straddle / underlying * 100, calibrated to ~80% of one-stdev expected move per rule of thumb). Surfaces three signal classes: HIGH_IV (implied >= 8% - earnings IV-crush opportunity, sell-premium structures pay; iron-condor or short-straddle setups apply); MODERATE (3-8% - directional plays viable depending on conviction); LOW_IV (<3% - boring print, skip unless directional thesis is strong). The Options Edge Brief uses HIGH_IV picks for short-vol structures, MODERATE for debit spreads aligned with directional bias, LOW_IV is generally filtered out. Wave 1 of the Options Edge Brief delivers the implied-move computation; Wave 2 will add the historical realized-move comparison (over prior 8 earnings) so the brief can flag systematic mispricing per ticker. Massive.com Options Starter tier required. Single-script API budget: 2 calls per qualifying ticker (chain + underlying snapshot). Falls back gracefully when earnings_calendar feeder hasn't run yet.
code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import requests
import time
import glob
import os
import random as _random
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())

BASE = 'https://api.massive.com'

API_KEY = (
    (CREDENTIALS.get('MASSIVE_API_KEY') or '').strip()
    or (CREDENTIALS.get('POLYGON_API_KEY') or '').strip()
)

WATCHLIST = set([
    'SPY', 'QQQ', 'IWM', 'DIA',
    'XLE', 'XLF', 'XLK', 'XLV', 'XLI', 'XLU',
    'AAPL', 'MSFT', 'NVDA', 'GOOGL', 'META', 'AMZN',
    'TSLA', 'AMD', 'NFLX', 'AVGO', 'COIN',
    'ORCL', 'CRM', 'ADBE', 'PLTR',
    'VXX', 'UVXY', 'SVXY', 'TQQQ', 'SQQQ',
    'MSTR', 'SMCI', 'RIVN', 'LCID', 'NIO', 'BABA', 'ARKK', 'GME', 'AMC', 'BB',
])

EARNINGS_LOOKAHEAD_DAYS = 7
EXPIRATION_BUFFER_DAYS = 21  # Allow expirations up to 21 days post-earnings (covers monthly cycles)

HIGH_IV_THRESHOLD = 8.0   # implied move >= 8% = HIGH_IV
LOW_IV_THRESHOLD = 3.0    # implied move <= 3% = LOW_IV

OUTPUT_COLUMNS = [
    'ticker', 'earnings_date', 'days_to_earnings',
    'underlying_price', 'atm_strike',
    'call_mid', 'put_mid', 'straddle_price',
    'implied_move_pct', 'implied_move_dollars',
    'expiration_used', 'dte_at_expiration',
    'signal_class', '_epoch',
]


def _emit_info_row(detail):
    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'ticker': 'INFO', 'earnings_date': '', 'days_to_earnings': None,
        'underlying_price': None, 'atm_strike': None,
        'call_mid': None, 'put_mid': None, 'straddle_price': None,
        'implied_move_pct': None, 'implied_move_dollars': None,
        'expiration_used': '', 'dte_at_expiration': None,
        'signal_class': 'NO_EARNINGS', 'error_detail': detail[:1500],
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    }], columns=OUTPUT_COLUMNS + ['error_detail'])


if not API_KEY:
    df = _emit_info_row(
        'MASSIVE_API_KEY (or POLYGON_API_KEY) credential is not set. Add it in '
        'Settings > Global Credentials. Sign up for Options Starter at $29/mo.'
    )
    GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
else:
    # Step 1: Load earnings calendar Parquet feed.
    # Path resolution: the unrestricted-tier executor runs from project root.
    earnings_paths = sorted(
        glob.glob('indexes/equities/earnings_calendar/*.parquet'),
        key=os.path.getmtime,
        reverse=True,
    )
    upcoming_earnings = []  # list of (ticker, earnings_date_str)
    if not earnings_paths:
        df = _emit_info_row(
            'No earnings_calendar Parquet found at indexes/equities/earnings_calendar/. '
            'Run the earnings_calendar_72h ingestion script first (or wait for its scheduled '
            'run). The Options Edge Brief earnings-implied-move feeder depends on it for '
            'forward-looking earnings dates.'
        )
        GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
    else:
        try:
            frames = []
            for p in earnings_paths[:5]:
                try:
                    frame = pd.read_parquet(p)
                except Exception:
                    continue
                if frame is None or frame.empty:
                    continue
                frames.append(frame)
            earnings_df = (
                pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True) if frames
                else pd.DataFrame(columns=['ticker', 'earnings_date', '_epoch'])
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            df = _emit_info_row(f'Could not read earnings_calendar Parquet: {exc}')
            GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
            earnings_df = None

        if earnings_df is not None:
            today_iso = now.date().isoformat()
            cutoff_iso = (now + timedelta(days=EARNINGS_LOOKAHEAD_DAYS)).date().isoformat()
            earnings_df = earnings_df[
                (earnings_df['ticker'].isin(WATCHLIST))
                & (earnings_df['earnings_date'] >= today_iso)
                & (earnings_df['earnings_date'] <= cutoff_iso)
            ]
            # Latest entry per ticker wins
            earnings_df = earnings_df.sort_values('_epoch', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['ticker'])

            for _, r in earnings_df.iterrows():
                upcoming_earnings.append((str(r['ticker']).upper(), str(r['earnings_date'])))

    if not upcoming_earnings:
        df = _emit_info_row(
            f'No watchlist tickers have earnings in the next {EARNINGS_LOOKAHEAD_DAYS} days '
            f'(per indexes/equities/earnings_calendar). This is normal between earnings seasons; '
            f'the feeder will populate naturally as quarterly cycles approach.'
        )
        GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
    else:
        rows = []
        errors = []
        auth_failed = False

        def _massive_get(url, params=None):
            params = dict(params or {})
            params['apiKey'] = API_KEY
            last_exc = None
            for attempt in range(2):
                try:
                    r = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=20)
                    if r.status_code in (401, 403):
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            f'Massive returned {r.status_code} - MASSIVE_API_KEY invalid '
                            f'or Options Starter tier is not active.'
                        )
                    if r.status_code == 429:
                        time.sleep(4.0 + _random.random() * 2.0)
                        continue
                    r.raise_for_status()
                    return r.json() or {}
                except requests.exceptions.RequestException as exc:
                    last_exc = exc
                    if attempt == 0:
                        time.sleep(2.0)
                        continue
                    raise
            if last_exc:
                raise last_exc
            return {}

        def _safe_float(v):
            if v is None:
                return None
            try:
                f = float(v)
            except Exception:
                return None
            if f != f:
                return None
            return f

        def _estimate_underlying_from_chain(contracts):
            # Derive spot via put-call parity: S ≈ K + (C - P) at any
            # strike with both call and put closes. Median across all
            # such strike-pairs gives a robust estimate (verified within
            # $0.10 of true close on AAPL/SPY/QQQ).
            #
            # Why: Massive Options Starter ($29/mo) does NOT entitle the
            # stocks-snapshot or last-trade endpoints (both return 403
            # NOT_AUTHORIZED). The previous-day aggs endpoint works but
            # rate-limits to ~2 requests before HTTP 429 - unworkable
            # for a 40-ticker watchlist. The options chain we already
            # pull is the only reliable underlying source on this tier.
            by_strike = {}
            for contract in contracts:
                details = contract.get('details') or {}
                day = contract.get('day') or {}
                strike = _safe_float(details.get('strike_price'))
                close = _safe_float(day.get('close'))
                ctype = str(details.get('contract_type') or '').lower()
                if strike is None or close is None or close <= 0.005:
                    continue
                if ctype not in ('call', 'put'):
                    continue
                slot = by_strike.setdefault(strike, {})
                slot[ctype] = close
            estimates = []
            for strike, sides in by_strike.items():
                if 'call' in sides and 'put' in sides:
                    estimates.append(strike + sides['call'] - sides['put'])
            if not estimates:
                return None
            estimates.sort()
            return estimates[len(estimates) // 2]

        for ticker, earnings_date_str in upcoming_earnings:
            if auth_failed:
                break
            time.sleep(0.4 + _random.random() * 0.2)

            try:
                earnings_dt = datetime.strptime(earnings_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            except Exception:
                errors.append(f'{ticker}:bad_earnings_date:{earnings_date_str}')
                continue
            days_to_earnings = (earnings_dt - now).total_seconds() / 86400.0

            # Fetch chain in window: from earnings date to earnings + buffer
            exp_gte = earnings_dt.date().isoformat()
            exp_lte = (earnings_dt + timedelta(days=EXPIRATION_BUFFER_DAYS)).date().isoformat()
            try:
                c_url = f'{BASE}/v3/snapshot/options/{ticker}'
                params = {
                    'expiration_date.gte': exp_gte,
                    'expiration_date.lte': exp_lte,
                    'expired': 'false',
                    'limit': 250,
                    'order': 'asc',
                    'sort': 'expiration_date',
                }
                chain_payload = _massive_get(c_url, params)
            except RuntimeError as exc:
                errors.append(f'{ticker}:chain:{exc}')
                auth_failed = True
                break
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(f'{ticker}:chain:{exc}')
                continue

            contracts = chain_payload.get('results') or []
            if not contracts:
                continue

            # Derive underlying spot from the chain via put-call parity.
            underlying_px = _estimate_underlying_from_chain(contracts)
            if underlying_px is None or underlying_px <= 0:
                errors.append(f'{ticker}:no_strike_pairs_for_parity')
                continue

            # Find earliest expiration AFTER earnings date (use it for the straddle).
            exp_to_contracts = {}
            for contract in contracts:
                details = contract.get('details') or {}
                exp_str = str(details.get('expiration_date') or '')
                if not exp_str or exp_str <= earnings_date_str:
                    continue
                exp_to_contracts.setdefault(exp_str, []).append(contract)

            if not exp_to_contracts:
                continue
            target_exp = min(exp_to_contracts.keys())
            target_contracts = exp_to_contracts[target_exp]

            # Find ATM call + ATM put: strike nearest underlying_px
            best_call = None
            best_put = None
            best_call_diff = float('inf')
            best_put_diff = float('inf')
            for contract in target_contracts:
                details = contract.get('details') or {}
                ctype = str(details.get('contract_type') or '').lower()
                strike = _safe_float(details.get('strike_price'))
                if strike is None:
                    continue
                diff = abs(strike - underlying_px)
                if ctype == 'call' and diff < best_call_diff:
                    best_call_diff = diff
                    best_call = (contract, strike)
                elif ctype == 'put' and diff < best_put_diff:
                    best_put_diff = diff
                    best_put = (contract, strike)

            if best_call is None or best_put is None:
                continue

            def _contract_mid(contract):
                last_quote = contract.get('last_quote') or {}
                bid = _safe_float(last_quote.get('bid'))
                ask = _safe_float(last_quote.get('ask'))
                if bid is not None and ask is not None and bid > 0 and ask > 0 and ask >= bid:
                    return (bid + ask) / 2.0
                # Fall back to last day close
                day = contract.get('day') or {}
                close = _safe_float(day.get('close'))
                if close is not None and close > 0:
                    return close
                vwap = _safe_float(day.get('vwap'))
                if vwap is not None and vwap > 0:
                    return vwap
                return None

            call_mid = _contract_mid(best_call[0])
            put_mid = _contract_mid(best_put[0])
            if call_mid is None or put_mid is None:
                continue

            atm_strike = best_call[1]  # call/put share the same ATM strike approx
            straddle = call_mid + put_mid
            implied_move_pct = (straddle / underlying_px) * 100.0 if underlying_px > 0 else None
            implied_move_dollars = straddle
            try:
                exp_dt = datetime.strptime(target_exp, '%Y-%m-%d').replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
                dte_at_exp = (exp_dt - now).total_seconds() / 86400.0
            except Exception:
                dte_at_exp = None

            if implied_move_pct is None:
                signal_class = 'UNKNOWN'
            elif implied_move_pct >= HIGH_IV_THRESHOLD:
                signal_class = 'HIGH_IV'
            elif implied_move_pct <= LOW_IV_THRESHOLD:
                signal_class = 'LOW_IV'
            else:
                signal_class = 'MODERATE'

            rows.append({
                'ticker': ticker,
                'earnings_date': earnings_date_str,
                'days_to_earnings': round(days_to_earnings, 1),
                'underlying_price': round(underlying_px, 4),
                'atm_strike': round(atm_strike, 4),
                'call_mid': round(call_mid, 4),
                'put_mid': round(put_mid, 4),
                'straddle_price': round(straddle, 4),
                'implied_move_pct': round(implied_move_pct, 2) if implied_move_pct is not None else None,
                'implied_move_dollars': round(implied_move_dollars, 4) if implied_move_dollars is not None else None,
                'expiration_used': target_exp,
                'dte_at_expiration': round(dte_at_exp, 1) if dte_at_exp is not None else None,
                'signal_class': signal_class,
                '_epoch': now_epoch,
            })

        if rows:
            df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=OUTPUT_COLUMNS)
            signal_priority = {'HIGH_IV': 0, 'MODERATE': 1, 'LOW_IV': 2, 'UNKNOWN': 3}
            df['_sort_key'] = df['signal_class'].map(signal_priority).fillna(3)
            df = df.sort_values(['_sort_key', 'days_to_earnings'], ascending=[True, True]).drop(columns=['_sort_key']).reset_index(drop=True)
        else:
            detail = '; '.join(errors) if errors else 'No qualifying earnings tickers had usable straddle data.'
            if auth_failed:
                detail = 'MASSIVE_API_KEY rejected. ' + detail
            df = _emit_info_row(detail)
        GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
